scope: Daily NSE cash long-only indicator research. Same-day trades use yesterday daily signals, not minute indicators. No orders or leverage.

families.name: Supertrend 7 / 2 flip
families.rule: Bullish direction change, Wilder ATR 7 and multiplier 2; exit bearish.

families.name: Supertrend 10 / 3 flip
families.rule: Bullish direction change, Wilder ATR 10 and multiplier 3; exit bearish.

families.name: Supertrend 14 / 3 flip
families.rule: Bullish direction change, Wilder ATR 14 and multiplier 3; exit bearish.

families.name: Supertrend 10 / 3 trend
families.rule: Bullish direction; allow re-entry after closing a trade, exit bearish.

families.name: Confirmed HH / HL breakout
families.rule: Strict 2-left/2-right pivots, two rising highs and lows; close crosses latest confirmed high; exit below latest confirmed low.

families.name: Ichimoku cloud breakout
families.rule: Close crosses above visible cloud, Tenkan > Kijun; 9/26/52, spans shifted +26; exit below cloud bottom.

families.name: Ichimoku TK cross
families.rule: Tenkan crosses above Kijun while close above visible cloud; exit Tenkan below Kijun.

families.name: Donchian 20 breakout
families.rule: Close above prior 20-session high; exit below prior 10-session low.

families.name: Donchian 55 breakout
families.rule: Close above prior 55-session high; exit below prior 20-session low.

families.name: EMA 9 / 21 cross
families.rule: Fast EMA crosses above slow; exit fast below slow.

families.name: EMA 20 / 50 cross
families.rule: Fast EMA crosses above slow; exit fast below slow.

families.name: MACD 12 / 26 / 9 cross
families.rule: MACD crosses above signal; exit below signal.

families.name: ADX / directional movement
families.rule: Plus DI crosses above minus DI with Wilder ADX14 > 20; exit plus DI below minus DI.

families.name: RSI 2 pullback
families.rule: Wilder RSI2 < 10 with close above SMA200; exit RSI2 > 70.

families.name: RSI 14 reclaim 30
families.rule: Wilder RSI14 crosses back above 30; exit RSI14 > 60.

families.name: Bollinger lower-band reclaim
families.rule: Close crosses back above SMA20 minus 2 population standard deviations; exit at/above SMA20.

families.name: Keltner upper breakout
families.rule: Close crosses above EMA20 plus 2 Wilder ATR20; exit below EMA20.

families.name: Stochastic oversold cross
families.rule: Slow K(14,3) crosses D(3) while K < 30; exit K > 80.

execution: Prior completed close generates signal; next open eligible only within +/-1 prior ATR of signal close. Rank candidates by prior 20-session average turnover, ties symbol. Initial 2 prior ATR stop; indicator reversal exits next open; otherwise stop first and holding cap close. No profit target. Existing positions cannot release same-day closing proceeds for new entries; at most 5 positions and 2 per current industry. Flat restart per evaluation window; force liquidation at last close with costs.
liquidity: Prior close >= Rs50; prior 20-session average turnover >= Rs10cr; ATR/price 0.5%-6%. Current constituents, not historical membership.

costs.note: Scenario costs; not actual broker tariffs or personal income tax.

pre_recent_selection: Choose recent candidate using earlier and middle base returns only, require both positive and >=30 closed middle trades. Rank minimum annualized return/max(drawdown,5) across those two periods; ties configuration id. Freeze before computing recent results. Choose middle candidate using earlier only, positive and >=30 trades. If no candidate qualifies stay cash. No pristine holdout: these market periods were inspected in earlier research.
exploratory_gate: Each base window positive, recent and middle doubled-cost positive, >=30 closed recent trades, no held-bar gaps. This is a screen, not statistical validation. All 144 comparisons disclosed; multiple-testing and survivorship bias remain.
